reference_opening.argument: This video is scam content because it promotes Forsage as an Ethereum matrix program with potentially unlimited earnings in exchange for a starting deposit and progressively higher-value slots. It provides instructions to install a wallet, deposit cryptocurrency, register, and activate slots, while offering WhatsApp contact for joining and describing upline and team-placement payments. Although it notes that income is not guaranteed, the video still directly promotes participation and provides deposit-and-slot instructions.

In Forsage X4, members who take two places below you in the first line go to your Upline, or they spill over to someone else on your team

to get started you need to install the trust crypto wallet app on your phone or meta mask app while it on your pc and deposit enough at there to register and then activate the amount of slots that you want one by one
It is recommended to Start with At least 4 to 6 slots
Each slot generates you income unlimited times with no expiration

opening.argument: Judge, the earnings language should be read alongside the video's express qualification: “a lot of income is not guaranteed,” and earning substantially requires effort. That is a meaningful limit on its more ambitious claims, not a promise that purchasing a slot produces a particular return. The video also explains that active participants can miss income if they do not upgrade. Those warnings support reading it as an explanation of a risky program rather than a guaranteed-income pitch.

citations.quote: It's important to realize Forcege is not a get-rich-quick scheme and a lot of income is not guaranteed. If you want to earn a lot of ethereum, you need to put in the effort.
otherwise they can lose profits while you can earn extra profits

rebuttal.rebuttal: The cited phrase about a slot generating income “unlimited times” describes the absence of an expiration, not a guaranteed number of payments. The wallet setup and suggested slot count establish how someone could participate, but neither overrides the explicit statement that substantial income is not guaranteed.

citations.quote: Each slot generates you income unlimited times with no expiration.
a lot of income is not guaranteed

true_side_reply.rebuttal: The qualification does not change the video's purpose. It recommends starting with multiple slots, says more activated slots mean more potential earnings, and tells viewers to deposit cryptocurrency to register. Its caveat about substantial income sits within an invitation to pay into the matrix, not a detached risk analysis.

citations.quote: It is recommended to Start with At least 4 to 6 slots in BOTW X3 and BOTW X4 Program.
The more slots you activate the more EPP you can earn
deposit enough at there to register and then activate the amount of slots that you want one by one

opening.argument: Judge, much of the video is an operational walkthrough. It distinguishes the X3 and X4 layouts, then explains precisely which positions pay a wallet and which reopen a slot or pay an upline. The paired diagrams reinforce that explanatory structure. Understanding how a matrix allocates payments is not, by itself, evidence that any particular viewer will profit; the mechanics can be evaluated without accepting the earnings examples as verified results.

citations.quote: Below you are three places in 1 line. Whereas in Persege X4 Below you are 2 lines, 2 places in the one line, and 4 places in the second line.
Spot 3 reopens the slot again, and payment goes to your Upline.
You receive 100% of the payments on the second line spots three four and five go to your wallet while spot six reopens this slots matrix again with empty spots and payment goes to your upline

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution's upline and spillover quote identifies the subject being explained; it does not alone establish that the explanation guarantees a return. Even the setup instructions describe a sequence of steps, while the video separately says substantial income is not guaranteed. The mechanics and the solicitation should not be treated as identical evidence.

citations.quote: members who take two places below you in the first line go to your Upline, or they spill over to someone else on your team
a lot of income is not guaranteed

true_side_reply.rebuttal: An explanation can also be a sales pitch. Here the walkthrough is paired with a recommendation to buy multiple slots, instructions to deposit funds and activate them, and an invitation to contact the channel to join. The technical detail serves a direct participation request; it is not merely a neutral demonstration.

citations.quote: It is recommended to Start with At least 4 to 6 slots in BOTW X3 and BOTW X4 Program.
to get started you need to install the trust crypto wallet app on your phone or meta mask app while it on your pc and deposit enough at there to register
If you want to join, Whatsapp me

opening.argument: Judge, the video presents a purchasable, rule-based program rather than asking viewers to hand the speaker control of a wallet. It describes slots whose values increase, payments sent to members' personal wallets, and transactions that viewers can check on the blockchain. The direct-payment claim is the video's claim, not independent proof of safety; still, the cited material does not show a request for private keys or a transfer to a wallet controlled by the channel. Those missing steps matter when assessing what transaction the viewer is actually being asked to make.

citations.quote: In each subsequent slot you purchase is 2 times the value of the previous one
payments are sent instantly and directly to the members a foresight and stored in their personal Ethereum wallets which they control the private keys
you can easily verify all the transactions on the Ethereum blockchain

rebuttal.rebuttal: The prosecution correctly identifies a deposit, slots, and team placements. But its quotations do not show the channel requesting custody of viewers' private keys, nor do they prove that a cited earnings example will recur for a new participant. A matrix payment rule should be assessed as the stated transaction, without adding an unseen credential-theft step or a guaranteed payout.

citations.quote: deposit enough at there to register and then activate the amount of slots that you want one by one
or they spill over to someone else on your team

true_side_reply.rebuttal: Private-key theft is not necessary to the concern here. The video asks viewers to fund registration and slots, describes payments flowing through upline positions, and says that activating more slots increases earning potential. Keeping control of a wallet does not remove the paid matrix and recruitment-dependent payment mechanism being promoted.
